Type: stool
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Modern High-Back Barstool, Set of 2, 43.5"H, Blue
Colors: Blue
Materials: Metal
This set of 2 contemporary barstools comes in a durable blue upholstery that tops black-finished metal legs. The foam padding and elastic suspension system help ensure the backs and seats stay firm and comfortable, while a distinctive flair adds a personal touch to any home or business. 19.5"W x 21.25"D x 43.5"H Durable fabric on metal frame The foam padding and elastic suspension system help keep the back and seat firm and comfortable. The distinctive design of these contemporary barstools brings a touch of personal style to any home or business. Simple assembly in 15-30 minutes Avoid moisture. Wipe clean with a soft, dry cloth. Free returns for 30 days. 1-year warranty.
